consumerRisk.promotionCredits: Spread across 36 monthly bill credits; not an immediate retail discount.
consumerRisk.paidEarly: Published device-promotion terms state bill credits end if the financed device is paid off early.
consumerRisk.cancelled: Published terms say contact T-Mobile before cancelling entire account; remaining credits can stop and remaining financed balance can become due.
consumerRisk.pickLock: Picks used for device deals remain allocated for their promotion/financing period; they cannot be casually reallocated.
consumerRisk.earlyPickCharge: T-Mobile's $15 Early Pick Charge applies to freeing a Pick tied to a partner benefit before a change window, not to immediately releasing a device-promotion Pick.
consumerRisk.unilateralRules: T-Mobile reserves the right to alter catalog/required Picks and says account changes can affect active promotions; see controlling terms.
consumerRisk.noLegalJudgment: The allocation design is verified; unlawful deception, intent to deny a discount and any typical consumer financial injury are not established.

caseStudyContext.usage: Two-line structure only; omit personal identifiers, household-specific discount amounts, screenshots and phone numbers from the public story.
caseStudyContext.observedQuestion: Is the advertised device incentive per line or constrained by a shared account-level benefit currency?
caseStudyContext.status: Generic two-line case replicated against carrier terms; purchase, bill credits and individual eligibility not independently tested.

remedies.title: Ask for an account-wide written illustration
